laws.rule: São Paulo state Lei 13.541/2009 bans smoking cigarettes, cigars, pipes and any other smoking product in indoor shared spaces, public or private: bars, restaurants, hotels, shops, offices, public transport and taxis. It does not cover open-air public spaces, homes, or venues set up only for smoking and signed as such at the entrance. Venues must put up a notice and ask offenders to stop or leave. Penalties are set by the state health-surveillance and consumer-defence bodies. A federal law (Lei 12.546/2011) also bans smoking in enclosed shared spaces and overrides the parts of the state law that conflict with it.
laws.penalty_signal: fines and sanctions from state health surveillance or consumer defence
laws.heading: Lei 13.541/2009

laws.rule: São Paulo state Lei 17.389/2021 bans letting off loud-bang fireworks and any noisy pyrotechnic device across the state, indoors or outdoors, on public or private land. Sight-only fireworks (visual effects with no bang) are excepted. The Supreme Court (STF, RE 1419760) held article 1 constitutional.
laws.penalty_signal: fine of 150 UFESP for a person, 400 UFESP for a company; doubled for a repeat within 180 days (UFESP is the state's fiscal unit)
laws.heading: Lei 17.389/2021
Lei 9.468/1996
laws.rule: São Paulo state Lei 9.468 of 27 December 1996 bans selling alcoholic drinks at bars, snack bars, restaurants, clubs, hotels, motels and similar places on land next to a state highway right-of-way run by the DER (the state roads department) and with direct access to that highway. Both the seller and the buyer are treated as breaking the law within their own part. Venues must post two signs (at least 25 x 35 cm), one at the entrance and one inside. Decreto 44.492/1999 sets the enforcement process. Federal Lei 11.705/2008 deals separately with federal highways.
laws.penalty_signal: fine of 35 UFESP at the citation date, doubled for a repeat; a repeat offender can lose its right of access to state highways
